title: Aspen Dental Provides $2.8 Million in Free Veteran Care
html:
More than 6,000 doctors and team members at Aspen Dental-branded practices cared for veterans on Nov. 7, advancing TAG’s five-year commitment to expand access to care.

The Aspen Group (TAG) shared the results of Aspen Dental’s annual Day of Service, held Saturday. More than 6,000 doctors and team members at participating Aspen Dental-branded practices provided free dental care valued at more than $2.8 million to more than 6,400 veterans in a single day, marking the most patients served in the event’s history.

During the veterans’ visits, doctors and teams focused on the most urgent dental needs, such as fillings, extractions, and denture repairs. The focus was on helping veterans find relief from dental pain and get back on the road to good oral health.

As a next phase, participating ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers will begin evaluating veterans identified by Aspen Dental doctors during the Day of Service as potential candidates for fixed, full-arch implant care. The centers will donate full-arch treatment to patients determined to be clinically eligible, up to a combined total of $1 million.

“For a veteran who’s been living with dental pain, getting access to care can make an incredible difference in their life,” said Bob Fontana, founder, chairman, and CEO of The Aspen Group. “We’ve always been committed to breaking down barriers to care, and I couldn’t be more proud of the doctors and team members from coast to coast who so generously volunteered their time and talents this past Saturday. There’s no better example of our culture in action.”

The 2026 Day of Service was the first milestone in TAG’s five-year, $100 million commitment to expand the Healthy Mouth Movement, TAG’s enterprise-wide initiative to create greater access to care and break down barriers for veterans and underserved communities nationwide. Through the commitment, announced in July, TAG will work to deliver up to $100 million in donated dental care and oral health education.

Aspen Dental’s support for veterans continues throughout November. Veterans who enroll in the Aspen Dental Savings Plan by Nov. 30 receive their first year of membership at no cost; annual renewal is available for $29 after the first year. Members save more than 25 percent on treatment, on average, and receive free exams and X-rays. The plan has no waiting periods, annual maximums, or exclusions based on age or preexisting conditions. The Aspen Dental Savings Plan is not insurance. Terms and conditions apply.

For a veteran without traditional dental insurance, that can mean the difference between delaying care and having an affordable way to move forward. It is one more barrier removed and one more path into care.

Building on this year’s Day of Service, Aspen Dental has launched a Day of Service Facebook group to keep veterans and their loved ones connected well beyond the one-day event. Welcomed by Dr. Nelson Nunez, an Army veteran and Aspen Dental dentist, the group gives members a place to share their experiences, swap tips, ask questions, and find support from others who understand the veteran care journey.

To learn more about Day of Service and Aspen Dental’s work with veterans, visit aspendental.com/dayofservice.

About The Aspen Group (TAG)

The Aspen Group (TAG) was built on the simple idea of bringing better health care to more people. TAG supports independent health care practices operating more than 1,400 locations in 46 states through five consumer health care brands: Aspen Dental®, ClearChoice Dental Implant Center®, WellNow Urgent Care®, Chapter Aesthetic Studio℠, and Lovet Pet Health Care℠. TAG invests in its team members through The Aspen Group University (TAG U), providing clinical training, leadership development, and career advancement opportunities across its network. For more information, visit teamtag.com.

About Aspen Dental

Aspen Dental, part of The Aspen Group (TAG), is committed to breaking down barriers to oral health care and helping patients put themselves first, starting with a healthy mouth. With nearly 1,100 Aspen Dental-branded offices across the United States, Aspen Dental practices offer comprehensive care and are supported by dedicated teams focused on making dental care more accessible and affordable. Through initiatives such as the Healthy Mouth Movement and Day of Service, Aspen Dental and its network continue to expand access to care for those who need it most. Aspen Dental-branded practices are independently owned and operated by licensed dentists. Aspen Dental Management, Inc. provides business support services to these practices.

For more information, visit aspendental.com.

About ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers

ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers, part of The Aspen Group (TAG), have helped restore hope and confidence in more than 250,000 patients across the United States through advanced oral treatments that can help improve overall health and quality of life. Equipped with digital design, 3D printing and intraoral scanning, virtual smile design, and a full-service, on-site lab, each ClearChoice Dental Implant Center is owned and operated by a licensed and experienced dentist, providing comprehensive dental implant treatment services in advanced, all-in-one treatment facilities.

For more information, visit clearchoice.com.
